answers.sql: SELECT h1.revenue_million - q2.revenue_million AS value FROM services q2, services h1 WHERE q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2' AND h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1'

SELECT h1.gross_profit_million - q2.gross_profit_million AS value FROM services q2, services h1 WHERE q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2' AND h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1'

SELECT (h1.gross_profit_million - q2.gross_profit_million) * 100.0 / (h1.revenue_million - q2.revenue_million) AS value FROM services q2, services h1 WHERE q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2' AND h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1'

SELECT (q2.gross_profit_million * 100.0 / q2.revenue_million) - ((h1.gross_profit_million - q2.gross_profit_million) * 100.0 / (h1.revenue_million - q2.revenue_million)) AS value FROM services q2, services h1 WHERE q2.entity='Apple' AND q2.fiscal_year=2024 AND q2.period='Q2' AND h1.entity='Apple' AND h1.fiscal_year=2024 AND h1.period='H1'
